map.由采样序列求信号能量: Signal energy from a sampled sequence
map.对离散时间信号 x[n] 计算总能量 E = Σ|x[n]|² 或平均功率 P: For a discrete-time signal x[n], compute total energy E = Sum|x[n]|^2 or average power P = E/N.
map.📖 查看「由采样序列求信号能量 使用指南」: View "Signal energy from a sampled sequence" guide
map.输入离散采样序列（空格或逗号分隔），求信号总能量。: Enter a discrete sampled sequence (space- or comma-separated) to find the total signal energy.
map.离散序列各样本平方和对信号总能量求和。: The sum of squares of each discrete-sample value gives the total signal energy.
map.对比不同幅度序列的能量差异。: Compare energy differences among sequences of different amplitudes.
map.能量 E = 1² + 2² + 3² = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14；单点: Energy E = 1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2 = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14; a single point 1 gives E=1.
map.若序列 2 4 6，则 E = 4+16+36 = 56，为原 14 的 4 倍: If the sequence is 2 4 6, then E = 4+16+36 = 56, four times the original 14 (amplitude-squared relation).
map.离散能量与功率有何区别？: What is the difference between discrete energy and power?
map.有限长序列求总能量；无限长常求平均功率（能量/长度）。: Finite-length sequences yield total energy; infinite-length ones usually yield average power (energy/length).
map.纲，若样本为电压则其平方为电压平方量纲。: the dimension; if samples are voltages then their squares are in voltage-squared dimension.
map.离散信号能量：E = Σx[n]²（全序列平方和）；联动卡：平均功率 = E ÷: Discrete signal energy: E = Σx[n]² (sum of squares over the whole sequence); linked cards: average power = E ÷ (N||1) (N the number of samples, falling back to 1 to avoid division by zero), RMS = √(E ÷ N). Validation: no strict validation; items separated by spaces or commas are parsed one by one, and empty input counts as 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; E converges for finite-energy signals, and RMS is the effective value.
